hints.title: City Degree Sum
hints.text: The network rank of two cities is the total number of directly connected roads to either city.

hints.title: Subtract Shared Edge
hints.text: If a direct road exists between the two cities, it is counted twice and must be subtracted once.

hints.title: Pairwise Enumeration
hints.text: Since n is at most 100, evaluate the network rank across all unique pairs of cities.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing road sets from scratch per pair takes O(n^2 * m) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Degree arrays and adjacency matrix allow O(1) lookup per city pair.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should accurately deduct 1 when an edge directly links the two chosen nodes.
